exact_statement: For iid Bernoulli bond percolation on every infinite connected locally finite quasi-transitive graph G with p_c(G)<1, G[p_c(G)] has no infinite clusters almost surely.
source_status: Exact statement verified in Hutchcroft arXiv:1605.05301; original P0043 intake locator recovered, book version not independently retrieved.

primary_sources.source_quote: If p_c(G)<1, then G[p_c] has no infinite clusters almost surely.
supports: finite susceptibility stated for p<p_c, not p=p_c
locality of critical probability for vertex-transitive graphs; does not itself assert absence of critical infinite clusters on all quasi-transitive graphs
